p6_b0.ocr: The data presented in the table elucidates the effects of varying concentrations of organic acids and sulfate on the production of key metabolites, specifically focusing on the metrics for acetate and sulfide. In the context of a controlled experiment involving wild-type (WT) and mutant (Mut) variants, the introduction of 20 mM lactate and 21 mM sulfate serves as a critical variable influencing metabolic outcomes.

p6_b1.ocr: Notably, the mean acetate concentration observed in the WT variant was 10.3 mM, while the Mut variant exhibited a slightly lower mean of 10.0 mM, indicating potential differences in metabolic efficiency or pathway utilization between the two genotypes. Furthermore, the sulfide levels, measured in millimolar concentrations, provide insight into the sulfur metabolism under these experimental conditions.
